grammar.attribute_header: Typed ATTRIB_CUSTOM-attrib owner pointer4 plus owner attribute-head and reciprocal next/previous chain pointers2/3. Observed owner kinds BODY/face/edge only; all pointers stay in initial geometry.
grammar.definition_fields: String generic_tag_attrib_def, integer schema fields[3,3,-1], literal namespace string generic_tag_attrib_def followed by one space. Definition strings are checked; no unobserved definition-object pointer is invented.
grammar.payload: Integer term_count1/2; each term integer ASCII byte length, short ASCII string, integer stored_index, integer component_count0/1, that many signed32-range integer components, separate integerzero terminator. No remaining tokens permitted.
grammar.native_correspondence: The full ordered term group (ASCII name,stored index,counted signed components) matches the separately framed native recipe name-table group exactly. Numeric components are never looked up as native design-object IDs.
grammar.byte_encoding: Observed integer token4+int64, string token7+u8 byte length+ASCII bytes. Exact payload replay preserves every parsed definition/schema/namespace/term byte.
grammar.namespace_scope: Native descriptor UUID namespaces are not literal ASM generic-tag namespaces. Both are retained separately and matches are scoped through the explicitly referenced same-asset history blob.

limitations: Circle source term(-1,index0,components[301]) matches two distinct initial edge owners: detached edge2 and an edge in the explicitly mapped source BODY. Both candidates are retained; neither is chosen.

Only initial geometry and observed generic tag term counts1/2 and component counts0/1 are admitted. Known timestamp and sketch-coedge attribute layouts are independently framed and excluded without interpreting sketch text. Other custom definitions cause unresolved coverage rather than being silently skipped. History snapshots, generic-tag count2+ component arrays, non-ASCII tags and persistent regeneration are outside this stage.
